blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation has earned two Gold awards at the 2026 FIABCI Philippines Property and Real Estate Excellence Awards, with Sierra Valley Gardens by RLC Residences winning the highest award under the Residential High-Rise category and The Victor by Robinsons Destination Estates recognized under the Specialized/Purpose-Built category.
The awards were recently presented during the FIABCI Philippines Awards Gala Night attended by the county’s leading property developers.

Organized by FIABCI-Philippines, the local chapter of the International Real Estate Federation, the Property and Real Estate Excellence Awards recognize outstanding developments for excellence across key aspects of real estate development. Robinsons Land’s winning entries, submitted under the Residential High-Rise and Specialized/Purpose-Built categories, were evaluated based on design quality, development execution, market performance, and environmental impact.
The two Gold-winning entries show how these standards can be reflected in both residential development and destination-building.

Sierra Valley Gardens is a multi-building residential development in Cainta, Rizal, designed for homeowners seeking comfort, convenience, and a more connected suburban lifestyle. Developed by RLC Residences, the residential arm of Robinsons Land, this award-winning development features efficient living spaces, nature-inspired amenities, and smart home features that support modern living.

The project’s appeal is strengthened by its location within Sierra Valley Destination Estate, Robinsons Land’s 18-hectare mixed-use development in Cainta and Taytay. Envisioned as an eastern gateway to Metro Manila, Sierra Valley brings together residential, retail, commercial, office, and lifestyle components in a master-planned setting, giving residents access to daily essentials, open spaces, and shared experiences within a growing estate.

The Victor, meanwhile, is the 60-meter award-winning landmark that serves as the visual and inspiring centerpiece of Bridgetowne, Robinsons Land’s premiere Destination Estate spanning Quezon City and Pasig. The estate brings together offices, residential towers, retail, hospitality, open spaces, mobility infrastructure, and public art.
Designed by Filipino-American artist Jefrë Manuel-Figueras, the stainless-steel sculpture pays tribute to the winning spirit of the Filipino, its resilience, and ambition.
The FIABCI award places focus on The Victor’s contribution to Bridgetowne: a landmark that strengthens the estate’s identity while creating a more memorable public experience.

As Gold winners, Sierra Valley Gardens and The Victor are now also eligible for endorsement to the upcoming FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence Awards, giving Robinsons Land the opportunity to represent and showcase Filipino excellence to global stage.
